messages:
Ava: Quick sync — we need a compact sales asset for enterprise buyers that ties security + SLAs + deploy modes together, plus a short webinar hook and inbound routing plan. Goal: 1 pager (sales-facing), 3 hero slides for webinar intro, and routing tags. Who can take point?
Sam: I can own the asset. want it tight — single page with 3 callouts (security, predictable performance, deployment options).
Riley: Add a short benchmark narrative we can use in the webinar opener — story arc: problem (sporadic latency), solution (dedicated + cache + batching), result (consistent p95 improvements and cost predictability). Keep numbers qualitative unless we vet infra tests.
Jin: Agreed on qualitative first. For the doc we should include an ops snippet and a short matrix showing tradeoffs (hosted vs dedicated vs private). I'll draft the matrix.
Priya: For inbound routing: recommend tags: enterprise:security, enterprise:sla, deploy:private. Then set rule: if leads include "security" or "compliance" keywords, route to AE-security queue; if they request SLA/throughput, route to enterprise-sales.
Sam: Draft messaging ideas (working title + bullets):
- Headline: "Secure, predictable LLM inference for production apps"
- Subhead: "Choose hosted, reserved, or private deployments with enterprise SLAs and audit-grade controls"
- 3 bullets: "Security-first: VPC, KMS/HSM, audit logs" | "SLA-backed performance: reserved capacity + latency SLOs" | "Operational economics: batching, caching, quantization to reduce unit costs"
- CTA: "Schedule a short demo — book a capacity review"
Riley: Webinar hooks: 1) 3-minute customer problem vignette 2) short live demo of route/fallback flow 3) benchmark narrative + Q/A. Suggest title: "Serving LLMs at Enterprise Scale — Security, SLAs, and Deployment Patterns"
Ava: Nice. Can we A/B headline variants? Variant A: "Security-first inference for regulated products" Variant B: "Predictable SLAs for high-throughput LLM apps" — we'll test which drives demo signups in paid social/webinar landing.
Jin: For the one-pager layout: top-left value prop, top-right short matrix, middle benchmark callout (neutral language), bottom-left routing snippet for sales ops, bottom-right quick CTA + links to technical appendix. I'll push a Figma frame. link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/enterprise-asset (placeholder)
Priya: Routing snippet (config example):
```
- match: "security, compliance, fedramp"
  route: "ae-security"
- match: "sla, latency, throughput"
  route: "enterprise-sales"
- match: "private, vpc, on-prem"
  route: "platform-sales"
```
Sam: I'll assemble the first draft by EOD Wed. Can someone volunteer to sanity-check benchmarking language to avoid overclaiming?
Riley: I'll review the benchmark wording — I'll flag any numbers that need infra sign-off.
Ava: Great. Also need 3 webinar slides by Thu morning (title slide, benchmark narrative slide, deployment patterns slide). Sam — include speaker notes for each.
Sam: Roger. I'll add speaker notes and a 1-paragraph webinar overview for promo copy.
launch-bot: Reminder set — draft due Wed 18:00 UTC, slides due Thu 09:00 UTC :spiral_calendar:
Ava: Thanks team. One more ask — add a short objection handling bullet for security-conscious buyers: "Data remains customer-controlled: no model tuning on customer corp data, optional private control plane, audit logs for every request." Keep that in the one-pager. :thumbsup:
